purpose: Remove the known fixed-geometry hydrostatic discretization drift from the conservative BC2 moving-geometry experiment without fitting any coefficient, so residual moving-history error can be attributed to non-equilibrium closure/geometry response rather than equilibrium preservation failure.

Zeng_Decker_2009.citation: Zeng, X. & Decker, M. (2009), Improving the Numerical Solution of Soil Moisture-Based Richards Equation for Land Models with a Deep or Shallow Water Table, Journal of Hydrometeorology 10, 308-319, DOI 10.1175/2008JHM1011.1
Zeng_Decker_2009.role: conceptual precedent that subtracting hydrostatic-equilibrium structure can remove water-table-related discretization error; BC2-B1 does not claim to reproduce the CLM discretization or equation.

literature_context.novelty_firewall: Hydrostatic-equilibrium subtraction is not claimed as novel. BC2-B1 is a source-anchored diagnostic control inside the LARE reduction study.

required_equilibrium_flux_path.derivation: chosen so the exact hydrostatic layer storages satisfy the conservative fixed-layer balances and dW_m/dt=q_90-q_H+theta_s*dHdt

corrected_flux_control.standard_candidate_flux: q_L(state,H) from the unchanged standard-LARE adjacent-layer and water-table closures used in BC2-B0
corrected_flux_control.property: If state=W_E(H), the corrected ODE follows dW_E/dt exactly up to numerical quadrature/integration floor.
corrected_flux_control.role: diagnostic equilibrium-path-preserving control only; not selected production physics

initial_state.source: exact BC2-A2 accepted initial Reference projection
initial_state.reason: Hold initial projection fixed so the only changed mechanism is the response flux correction.

comparison.reference: same BC2-A2 full-order geometry/output used by BC2-B0
metrics: max absolute total unsaturated storage error

hard_requirements: fine route numerically qualified for all four histories
adjudication.relative_support_rule: B1 is relatively supported as a deconfounding control only if it is component-wise noninferior to B0 on total-storage error, cumulative-qH error and sign-mismatch count over all four frozen histories, is noninferior on reversal-step difference for WT_CYCLE where B0 explicitly persists the reversal sequence, and strictly improves at least one of those governed components.
adjudication.fixed_geometry_attribution_rule: WT_HOLD is interpreted separately. A material reduction of WT_HOLD storage/exchange drift supports attribution of the B0 stationary error to hydrostatic discretization rather than moving-volume algebra.

pre_execution_baseline_clarification.reversal_authority: The B0 closeout explicitly persists candidate/reference reversal steps only for WT_CYCLE; no synthetic reversal value is inferred for WT_HOLD, WT_RISE or WT_FALL.
pre_execution_baseline_clarification.relative_support_revision: Component-wise B0 comparison uses total-storage error, cumulative-qH error and sign-mismatch count for all four histories, plus reversal-step difference for WT_CYCLE only.
pre_execution_baseline_clarification.scientific_effect: No B1 response has been observed; this only aligns the preregistered comparator with the information actually persisted by the predecessor authority.
